name: fable-harness
description: Spec-anchored workflow for autonomous coding runs on GPT-6 Astra in Codex: brief, run, verify, checkpoint. astra mode has Astra implement each slice; astra-crew routes implementation to gpt-5.6-sol or gpt-5.6-luna subagents by task class. Same spec contract as the Claude Code plugin in this repo.

interface.shortDescription: Brief, run, verify, checkpoint on GPT-6 Astra
interface.longDescription: One durable spec per project, effort chosen at session start, fresh-context verification by a read-only subagent, and a checkpoint for stopping mid-slice. In astra-crew mode Astra leads and Sol or Luna implement by task class.
